bidder_name: WAM Capital Limited
notes: Built from amaysim and WAM releases on WAM Capital's financialfilings page. Bid implementation agreement dated 14 Dec 2020, announced 15 Dec 2020 (announce_date), after amaysim agreed to sell its mobile business to Optus: off-market bid of 1 WAM share per 2.7 amaysim shares (implied A$0.833 at WAM's A$2.25 close on 14 Dec; the default) or A$0.695 cash (equal to the midpoint of amaysim's expected wind-up distributions of A$0.665-0.725), or a mix. Prices recorded are the cash alternative; the stated premium (24.4% to the 30 Oct 2020 close, 28.4% to 1-month VWAP) is for the scrip value, so premium_pct_announced is blank. Conditions: shareholder approval of the Optus sale (EGM 21 Jan 2021), a 50.1% minimum and customary conditions, all to be waived once the sale completed; no independent expert (not required under s640). On 18 Jan 2021 WAM raised the terms to 1 WAM share per 2.675 amaysim shares (implied A$0.856) or A$0.70 cash (price_raised Y). Optus sale completed and conditions freed 1 Feb 2021; bidder's and target's statements 2 Feb 2021, offer open and unconditional. WAM held a controlling stake by 12 Feb 2021 and 66.98% on 22 Mar 2021; offer closed 30 Mar 2021 (outcome_date, not extended); removed from the official list 6 Apr 2021. WAM became a substantial holder only on 2 Feb 2021, so its pre-bid stake was under 5%. Equity value computed: 307,375,144 shares (amaysim release of 23 Mar 2021) x A$0.695 = A$213.6m (A$256m at the scrip value). Under the offer terms, consideration for acceptances after the distribution record date is reduced by the A$0.50 major distribution. bidder_type trade follows the existing WAM rows. The 2019_2020 and 2021_2022 files left this as unchecked or outside their period.
